purpose: Provider-aligned routing contract for Palantir AIP, Ontology, Gotham, Apollo and JupyterLab Code Workspaces.

AIP.role: agent reasoning, LLM workflows, automations and evals

Ontology.role: objects, links, properties, actions, functions and operational state

Gotham.role: authorized defense/intelligence operational workflows over dynamic ontology data

JupyterLab.role: Foundry Code Workspace for analysis, models, notebooks and Ontology interaction
requires: AIP enabled for AIP coding agent

routing_policy: Use AIP for model-assisted reasoning and agent workflows.
Use the Ontology as the governed operational source of truth rather than unmanaged agent memory.
Use Gotham only for data and workflows exposed to the authorized Gotham enrollment.
Use Apollo for governed software delivery, never as ambient remote execution authority.
Use JupyterLab Code Workspaces for exploratory analysis, model development and notebook-based Ontology work.
Re-authorize every cross-plane action and preserve identity, markings, provenance and audit logs.
truthfulness_rule: Configuration flags describe intended integration only. They never imply Palantir licensing, enrollment, entitlement, credentials, connectivity or government affiliation.

terminology.jupiter: Normalized to JupyterLab because current Palantir documentation exposes JupyterLab through Code Workspaces; no Palantir product named Jupiter was verified.
